meta.name: research-prospect
meta.description: Run ad-hoc web research on a prospect (company URL or person) — Firecrawl scrapes the marketing site, key pages (pricing, careers, blog), and surfaces a brief. Read-only. Use when the user says 'research this prospect', 'tell me about [company]', 'do a deep dive on [domain]', 'pull a brief on this lead', or 'crawl the marketing site for [name]'. Side-effecting on the Firecrawl side (API call), no local DB writes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速调研潜在客户，生成公司简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在接触客户前快速了解对方公司情况
copy.tagline_en: Quickly research prospects and generate company briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand a company before reaching out

howto.what: 当你提供公司网址或人名时，Claude会用Firecrawl抓取该公司的营销网站、定价、招聘、博客等页面，生成一份摘要简报。只读不写入数据库。
howto.when: 当用户说出“研究这个潜在客户”、“告诉我关于某公司”或“深入了解某域名”等话时触发。

say.text: 研究一下这个潜在客户 Acme Inc。
提取 ABC 公司的简报。

howto.what_en: When you provide a company URL or person name, Claude uses Firecrawl to scrape the company's marketing site, key pages (pricing, careers, blog), and produces a summary brief. Read-only, no local DB writes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'research this prospect', 'tell me about [company]', 'do a deep dive on [domain]', etc.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for the company URL.

say_en.text: Do a deep dive on example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape and produce a brief.

say_en.text: Pull a brief on ABC company.
say_en.note: Output includes a key facts table.
